thread:
rachel: FYI I opened a consolidation PR that harmonizes a few glossary keys, trims duplicate phrasebank tags, and updates three SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5067 — please scan for anything risky before I merge tomorrow morning. :wave:
diego: which SDKs are touched?
rachel: JS, Python, and a tiny Go example. JS param names move to snake_case in examples; Python example swaps the old model alias to the catalog id. Go only changes an import path comment.
samira: can we avoid changing the canonical quickstart's visible text? lots of customers copy that verbatim.
rachel: yes — for public quickstarts I left the visible values as-is and added an inline "recommended" comment showing the new canonical form. For internal howtos I switched to the explicit ids.
diego: paste the deprecation blurb so editorial can sign off on tone.
rachel: sure: "Deprecated: alias `gpt-legacy` is scheduled for removal. Use catalog identifiers such as `rw/gpt-small` for stable results. See migration notes."
toni: nit: make it shorter and scannable: "Deprecated: `gpt-legacy`. Use `rw/<model-id>`."
mika: editorial note — prefer 'we' for instructions and avoid imperative framing that sounds like orders. also: allow contractions in conversational examples but not in security/auth warnings.
rachel: added a 2-line addition to style-guide.md with examples. One sample change: 

Instead of: "You must set your API key."
Use: "Set your API key." or "To use the SDK, set your API key."

mika: that example looks good. Also suggested we standardize on sentence case for headings (not title case) in the SDK snippets.
diego: are we adding redirects for renamed glossary anchors? I saw a rename of "inference service" -> "serving runtime" in the PR which could break links.
rachel: added redirect anchors in glossary.yml and left HTML anchor duplicates in the glossary pages so old links still resolve. Also ran a globe search to update internal links in docs/* to the new anchor.
samira: migration helpers would be handy; can you add quick sed/rg/gawk lines?
rachel: added a migration section with examples. e.g.:

Mac-safe sed: `rg "gpt-legacy" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i '' "s/gpt-legacy/rw\/gpt-small/g" {}`
Linux sed: `rg "gpt-legacy" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i "s/gpt-legacy/rw\/gpt-small/g" {}`
Git-friendly: `git grep -l "gpt-legacy" | xargs -n1 git apply -p0 -R` (and preview with `git grep`).

diego: small request: include a single-line `npm`/`pip` upgrade for snippet consumers (in case client API changed).
rachel: added both: `npm i @redwoodai/sdk@latest` and `pip install --upgrade redwood-sdk` in the migration note.
build-bot: preview: docs-site build #5067 available at https://deployments.preview/redwood/docs/5067 :white_check_mark:
toni: I ran linkcheck locally; found one external support link that 404s. Looks like it references the old support KB — you added a redirect?
rachel: yep, redirect to support/faq-auth in the PR. Also fixed two internal anchors that had stray whitespace.
mika: editorial will do a quick pass after merge for contraction guidance and heading sentence-case.
samira: CI/regenerate-snapshots should run after merge. can we schedule it as part of the PR?
rachel: yes added a CI job: docs/regenerate-snapshots (#2830009999) in the PR.
diego: timeline: if nobody objects, please merge in the morning so i can add the release-note entry before the cut.
toni: no blockers from eng.
mika: editorial ok to review after merge.
samira: thanks all  will follow-up if my JS check finds any missed param cases.
rachel: thanks team — i'll merge by 09:00 PT unless someone flags something overnight. :rocket:
